clear_baselines.workload: One dependent fixed-length autoregressive stream; actual MLP, argmax and next one-hot input at every step
clear_baselines.resident_gpu_contract: GPU argmax/state update; no interstep host delivery. Primary GPU comparator.
clear_baselines.host_delivery_contract: All eight logits copied to CPU after every step; separate streaming comparator.

cold_setup_contract: The warm-epoch costs exclude initial HE-key setup. The separately reported cold-epoch full-pool cost is a conservative upper bound on that setup, because it also generated a separate cold pool. No independent-batch denominator is credited to this dependent stream.
source_fingerprint_contract: Every rep4gpu module plus runner, fixture and baseline sources; frozen throughout four-role consumption.
amortization: Exactly T dependent tokens consume every prepared row, square row and input mask; no independent-batch or replay denominator.
timing_contract: Isolated replay retains all local protocol arithmetic, serialization, hashes, MAC checks and fresh entropy draw cost. Exchange dispatch/wait and local TLS cryptography are omitted. Per-phase role maxima model the current barrier schedule on ideal confidential channels; no physical perfect-network or complete MPC latency claim.
next_token_contract: Checked public signed logits determine lowest-index argmax; next input is that public one-hot token.

ideal_confidential_channel.aggregation: Sum of per-phase maxima of isolated role-local median times; no socket-time subtraction.
ideal_confidential_channel.preprocessing_accounting: Unchanged: charge the actual fresh preprocessing pool cost per distinct one-use row pack, plus separately reported model/input/setup stages. Replay creates no new query capacity.

recorded_live_timing_contract: The fresh successful TLS execution was instrumented to copy exact byte fixtures. Its live wall time includes that recording overhead; it is diagnostic, not an uninstrumented latency sample.
replay_accounting: Only steps_served distinct fresh rows count. Repeats and warmups reproduce one fixed private fixture and never increase preprocessing capacity. Fresh native costs retain this recording pool denominator.
